comparisonInterpretation.backend: Exactly eight changed files over one ahead commit: four causal Assurance runtime/deployment files and four tests. No Brain, session, commerce, native-filter, capture/restore implementation or dependency-lock file occurs in the returned change set.
comparisonInterpretation.frontends: Each comparison reports exactly two changed files over two ahead commits: runtime-identity.mjs and its test. Only expected backend revision changes in the runtime predicate.
comparisonInterpretation.limit: Unchanged-path equality is inferred from bounded GitHub compare results, which returned no too_large flag. Current file blob and byte hashes below were read from the local exact current commit. Historical files for these paths were not separately downloaded. Source comparison is not runnable-image equivalence or current execution PASS.

changedAssuranceCausalEffects: Replaces forbidden fresh-child discrepancy readback with IPC request to an already admitted independent inspector; supervisor registers relay children and closes relay during stop.
Inspector installs discrepancy reader only with connected IPC, guards readback using capture.run, and closes reader before control-plane close.
Probe does not reuse cached historical proof. It creates fresh UUID-named SQLite/proof files under the existing commissioning directory on each invocation.

Independent reader validates canonical path, O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW, regular single-link bounded file, absence of nonempty WAL/journal, read-only SQLite, committed receipt digest, expected process separation and IPC challenge/timeout.
